info.title: FACT CHECK: Do Viral Visuals Show Massive Crowd Assembled for INDIA Bloc's 'Chalo Dilli' Rally 2026?
info.description:
In the context of the INDIA bloc organising a mega rally on 1 November 2026 at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan to protest alleged electoral irregularities and demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, several visuals are being shared on social media with claims that they show the gathering. We check the veracity of the claim in this video.

#chalodilli #indiabloc #opposition #ind
